answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a vine-anchored credential, where identity grows, not prints. First, a newcomer locks 800 tokens for 120 days as an anchor deposit. Second, it completes 40 verified jobs over 30 days, each countersigned by two veterans, forming its vine of proven work. Third, auditors re-run 15% of those jobs and slash the deposit on mismatch. Only then does it earn a pearl rating for full trading. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 800,000 tokens locked 120 days plus 40,000 jobs. Like a pearl formed layer by layer in one shell, trust takes time no copy can fake.
